# Version 4.156.0 (Unreleased)
> **Rendering reliability and platform alignment**

## Highlights

Upcoming changes improve Android frame pacing, Uno 7 integration and native callback reliability. Additional fixes address Linux HarfBuzz load-order crashes, Unicode decoding and WebAssembly linking. Apple deployment requirements rise, and Uno consumers need to account for a new package baseline and CPU-backed SKSwapChainPanel behavior.

## Breaking Changes

- **Update Apple deployment targets** — Native SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp require macOS 11 or iOS, tvOS and Mac Catalyst 14. Managed iOS/tvOS minimums rise to 14, while managed macOS 12 and Mac Catalyst 15 minimums remain unchanged. Raise application deployment targets where needed; the lower native floor does not replace a higher managed or framework requirement. ([#5383](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5383))
- **Migrate Uno views to Uno 7 and .NET 10** — Non-Windows Uno views require Uno 7 and net10.0. SKSwapChainPanel now derives from Grid, paints through a CPU surface and reports null GRContext; use SKCanvasElement for GPU rendering. Remove RaiseOnUnsupported usage. Legacy per-platform runtime packages and pre-Uno 7 WasmShell linking are retired; migrate to Uno.Sdk's unified renderer and .NET SDK WebAssembly pipeline. Windows package facades retain the WinAppSDK control. ([#5377](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5377))
- **Keep SKData copy lengths within the source array** — SKData.CreateCopy(byte[], ulong) now throws ArgumentOutOfRangeException when the requested length exceeds the array. Pass a length within the source buffer instead of relying on an out-of-bounds native read. ([#5429](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5429))
- **Use one encoded unit for character-code conversion** — StringUtilities.GetUnicodeCharacterCode validates encoded byte width: use Utf8 for ASCII, Utf16 for BMP characters and Utf32 for supplementary characters. Empty, multi-character and multi-unit inputs throw ArgumentException. GetString(byte[], SKTextEncoding) now throws ArgumentNullException rather than NullReferenceException for null arrays; update exception handling if it relied on the old exception. ([#5506](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5506))
- **Use rebuilt WebAssembly archives for WebGPU** — Newer-than-.NET-8 WebGPU consumers require rebuilt libSkiaSharp.a archives containing emdawnwebgpu's C++ support. Update packaged assets together, or rebuild custom archives with Graphite enabled; old archives and GPU-disabled custom archives do not satisfy this link contract. The .NET 8 built-in WebGPU path remains unchanged. ([#5316](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5316))

## Engine

- **SkSL and GLES correctness** — Same-milestone Skia m156 updates reject shader slot-count overflow and invalid runtime-effect types earlier. Ganesh GL also stops using an invalid BGRA8-as-RGBx upload configuration on GLES; readback behavior is unchanged. ([#5489](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5489), [#5500](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5500))

## Bug Fixes

- **Display-paced Android texture rendering** — Automatic continuous GLTextureView rendering, including MAUI Android SKGLView.HasRenderLoop, follows display callbacks instead of swap throughput. Painting stays on the GL worker; explicit render requests remain independent rather than being capped to the display rate. ([#5345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5345))
- **Native boolean callbacks match their ABI** — Skia callbacks use one-byte native boolean values, and HarfBuzz callbacks use four-byte hb_bool_t values, while public managed delegates retain bool. This corrects callback interoperability, including Mono ARM64 interpreter returns and false-returning HarfBuzz glyph-name callbacks. ([#5479](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5479))
- **HarfBuzz stays isolated from system copies on Linux** — Internal HarfBuzz calls bind to the bundled implementation, preventing incompatible private objects from crossing into a system HarfBuzz loaded by GTK. The fix covers both standard and NoDependencies Linux libraries without changing exported entry points. — ❤️ [@VirgilMing](https://github.com/VirgilMing) ([#5352](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5352))
- **WebGPU linking no longer compiles port C++ in applications** — emdawnwebgpu support is compiled into libSkiaSharp.a instead of passing C++20 flags through the application link. This avoids rejecting application C sources; the required JavaScript glue remains a link input rather than deployed application content. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5316](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5316))
- **Unicode character codes decode at the correct width** — Single-unit UTF-8 and UTF-16 inputs no longer fail through a four-byte decoder, and UTF-32 accepts single BMP characters as well as supplementary characters. Invalid character input now reports the correct parameter name. ([#5506](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5506))
- **C-string buffer over-read fixed** — Corrects a native buffer over-read in FromCString. ([#5429](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5429))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Disposed front-buffered streams release borrowed references** — Disposing SKFrontBufferedManagedStream clears its reference to the wrapped stream even when disposeUnderlyingStream is false. The borrowed stream is not disposed; its caller remains responsible for disposal. ([#5327](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5327))
- **Less allocation during copying and shaping** — Valid managed image pixel copies avoid an intermediate SKData allocation. HarfBuzzSharp pools UTF-32 string encoding buffers and avoids native feature-string allocation while preserving decoding and legacy-target behavior. ([#5052](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5052), [#5060](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5060), [#5230](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5230))

## Platform

- **Updated Windows rendering dependencies** — Bundled ANGLE advances to chromium/8118, and library dependencies align with Windows App SDK 1.7.250909003. These updates do not raise the declared Windows runtime minimum. ([#5321](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5321), [#5390](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5390))
